bullets: Added a standalone CLI binary build that ignores repository .env and .env.local files so a project folder can no longer override the SDK runtime API base URL.
Fixed the model selector to show one discounted Freebucks price in an accent color instead of a crossed-out regular price beside the sale price.
Stopped loading Freebucks picker notice copy and metered-tier landing notice so each row shows only its hourly price with the daily pool and reset countdown in the header.
Added prepaid annual subscription support so users can buy a one-time yearly plan that extends without a gap until a renewal date.
Named the unreachable session host on network failures so the landing screen reports which backend host could not be reached and points to alternate connectivity.
Changed the streak perk copy to promise Freebucks every Pacific day, matching the streak clock so the daily meter does not read as a double pay.
Raised the GLM 5.3 Flash price ceiling to 0.14 prompt and 0.45 completion to fence out re-priced cheap-band endpoints while keeping cheaper providers available.
Removed the Imprezia ad provider so only Gravity, first-party, and house ad networks can serve ads and no credentials can re-enable the deleted provider.
Added an on-demand SDK history compaction command that rewrites stored message history synchronously and reports prior and next token totals.
Added X hashed-email matching for paid-social conversions by normalizing attribution and conditionally including hashed email only for the X platform.
Renamed and narrowed the ban-exempt constant so it waives only the sticky third-party client flag plus ban-event row and account downgrade, not detection itself.
Added a Supabase CPC format experiment module and V3 invitation card that gates authenticated Tier 1 Mac and Linux Desktop users behind v1 billing for the agentic arm.
Consolidated email hashing for Meta and paid-social CAPI senders so every vendor receives a trimmed, lowercased, SHA-256-hashed email plus IP address where supported.
